name: print-social-black-friday-campaign-story-set-cobalt
title: Black Friday campaign set in cobalt with tags, starbursts and interface parodies
whatItIs: A collage of vertical ads for a supplement brand. Elements include a phone with a tag 'Black Friday is calling...' on frosty background, a November calendar covered in sale stickers, folder-tab vitamin lists, iMessage-style chat bubbles, red Target baskets, a 'NEW LAUNCH' calendar square, and orange banner 'BLACK FRIDAY STARTS NOW!' with 'Use code: BFSALE'.
whatItMeans: Busy but joyful; familiar interface parodies make a promo feel like fun content rather than an ad.
techniques: Parody everyday interfaces (calendar, phone call, iMessage) to frame sale messages.
Keep one cobalt base and add green, orange and red badge colours.
Pile stickers, tags and starbursts on top of mock UI.
Use a repeatable strip of campaign phases as a header.
Break the pattern with a real product photo with retail props.

vocabulary.definition: Mimicking a familiar interface to deliver a message.
A header showing stages of a campaign.
A badge-shaped graphic announcing a discount.
A tall 9:16 layout used for stories.
